name: New York by Night Notable Locations (Lore)

text.content: New York's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} are not organized around a single building but a network of satellite chantries answering to one central house, collectively known as the Chantry of the Five Boroughs. Historically a bastion against the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}, a hotbed of internal intrigue, and later a deprogramming center for captured @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Cainites, the network has once again rededicated itself under High Regent Aisling Sturbridge to the study of Thaumaturgy. Satellite chantries change location and charter roughly every seven years, a holdover from the days when the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} presence in the city was under constant @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} threat, though most @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} assigned to a subhouse remain in New York even after it relocates or is repurposed.

pages.name: Barnard College (Central Chantry of the Five Boroughs)

text.content: Hidden within the halls of the prestigious women's college at Broadway and 120th Street, Barnard College has always housed the seat of the high regent and the largest occult library of any of New York's @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} chantries. Its @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} focus mainly on administration, serving as liaisons to Vienna and as a communications hub for the satellite chantries; assemblies of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} often gather here for convocations and statements of clan business. Its location, bordering the notoriously Setite domain of Morningside Park, gives many visiting Kindred pause.

Grown from the private quarters of a previous high regent into a richly appointed 12th-floor office space at Madison Avenue and 77th Street, the Maupassant Room is where the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} meet with Kindred of other clans, and is one of the few chantries whose existence is known outside Clan @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere}. Little actual Thaumaturgical research happens here beyond a single Hermetic laboratory used to demonstrate rituals to outsiders; its resident regent, Eugenio Estevez, treats the chantry chiefly as a stage for political leverage — a use some conservative @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} consider a distasteful "whoring out" of the clan's sorcery, though Estevez points out it is little different from the clan's historic role as advisors to princes and mortal rulers alike.

A 13-story French Second-Empire apartment building at Central Park West and 75th Street, recently acquired by developers with @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} ties, the Kenilworth is the largest chantry in the New York network, its 42 "apartments" converted into sunproofed havens, libraries, laboratories, and lounges. Presided over by the traditionalist High Regent Lord Ephraim Wainwright, the Kenilworth embodies the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere}'s stodgiest, most xenophobic instincts, focusing purely on traditional Hermetic sorcery and treating any interest in Necromancy or non-Western blood magic as grounds for censure. It was here, in the aftermath of the Battle of New York, that Kenilworth thaumaturges developed a set of new rituals — Blood Into Water, Luminous Vitae, and Obscure the Malice — meant to help the city's Kindred conceal the evidence of violence and shore up the Masquerade.

Housed in a turn-of-the-century Gothic mansion at Fifth Avenue and 92nd Street, originally built for financier Felix Warburg and converted to the Jewish Museum in 1947, this chantry studies numerology and Kabbalah and serves as the center of House Hashem, an internal @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} faction. Its all-male membership (not exclusively Jewish, though predominantly so) refocused on scholarship after Eugenio Estevez, once its regent, was promoted away to the Maupassant Room and replaced by a leader drawn from within the chantry's own ranks.

pages.name: Madison Square and Madison Square Garden (Elysium)

text.content: Declared Elysium by Prince Pro Tempore Calebros during his brief reign, Madison Square Garden began as a single conference box observed only on the last event-free day of the month, but was formally expanded to the whole venue after a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZFYurbvAHfaRguYI]{Brujah} and a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} came to blows on its floor. When a rumor spread that Elysium had been extended to "all of Madison Square as well as the Garden," Calebros simply made the rumor true rather than fight it, and both the square and the garden — two streets over and five streets up from one another — remain Elysium to this night, bound by the standard Traditions and enforceable by the prince or, in his absence, the sheriff.

pages.name: Munsee-Hudson Expediting and Storage (Former Sabbat Stronghold)

text.content: Located along the Henry Hudson Parkway in the Bronx, this shipping company's offices once served as the last organized stand of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} in New York — a haven and weapons cache owned by a consortium of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra} and used by Archbishop Polonia during the final @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} counteroffensive. Now abandoned and repeatedly ransacked by gangs of both Kindred and kine, the graffiti-covered complex stands as the grim companion piece to Calebros' own vacated Grand Central sanctum in Manhattan — twin monuments to a war that is, officially, over.

At the southern tip of Manhattan, Wall Street was long the heart of the domain of Prince Michaela, a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} whose surviving childer now jealously guard what they consider their inherited legacy following her Final Death. Newcomer @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} accuse Michaela's brood of violating clan tradition by refusing to share the district's resources, while her childer maintain no such tradition exists; no Kindred, in or out of New York, has a clear picture of how many vampires actually profit from the Wall Street financial machine, since investments can be managed from anywhere — a fact other clans are quietly exploiting to pick up whatever influence Michaela's brood lets slip.

vtmlarp.source: New York by Night, 2nd Edition, Chapter Two: The Face of the City
